summary: 30-year-old European woman visiting Colorado for a conference pinned under a 1,500-lb boulder that broke free ~30 ft above her on North Table Mountain near Golden; unconscious with multiple fractures, legs pinned. Freed after a 2+ hr extrication (crews hauled a hydraulic spreader in pieces up the mountain; airbags used) by 10+ agencies; high-angle rope hoist to a ridge, then a 45-min carry up a snowy hill to a Flight For Life helicopter; flown to hospital. (ART mission 2017-16)
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team; Golden Fire Department; West Metro Fire Department; Flight for Life
notes: ART mission 2017-16. Mechanism confirmed by news coverage: boulder broke free ~30 ft above and struck her (rockfall). Two Littleton Fire paramedics who happened to be hiking tended her until crews arrived. Date verified: Wednesday 2017-04-05 (GearJunkie dateline; West Metro Fire tweet 4/5/2017).
